name: Kappa and Meen Curry
ingredients: 500g firm white fish (king fish or sardine)
instructions: 1. Boil cubed tapioca in water with salt until tender, drain, and set aside.
2. In a pan, sauté mustard seeds, dried red chilies, and curry leaves in coconut oil. Add grated coconut and sauté until light golden; mix this into the cooked tapioca.
3. For the fish curry, heat oil and sauté ginger, garlic, and curry leaves. Add chili, turmeric, and coriander powders.
4. Add tamarind extract and water, bringing it to a simmer.
5. Carefully place fish pieces into the gravy and cook until the fish is tender and the oil floats to the top.
6. Serve hot with the prepared tapioca.
description: Kappa and Meen Curry is the quintessential soul food of Kerala. Originally a staple for laborers and farmers due to the abundance of tapioca, it has evolved into a beloved culinary tradition, symbolizing the coastal state's deep connection to seafood and tropical produce.
